description: This file declares the QuicCryptoStream class, which manages cryptographic handshake messages in the QUIC protocol, including methods for handling crypto frames, key derivation, encryption, and handshake state management.

classes.name: QuicCryptoStream
classes.description: Abstract class managing cryptographic handshake messages in QUIC, providing interfaces for crypto frame handling, key management, encryption, handshake state, and related cryptographic operations.

classes.name: CryptoSubstream
classes.description: Internal structure managing per-packet number space state for crypto frames, including sequencer and send buffer.

methods.name: ExportKeyingMaterial
methods.description: Derives a new secret of specified length based on label, context, and stream's negotiated subkey secret; only supported in IETF QUIC.

methods.name: WriteCryptoData
methods.description: Writes crypto data at a specified encryption level to the stream.

methods.name: EarlyDataReason
methods.description: Returns the reason why 0-RTT data was accepted or rejected.

methods.name: encryption_established
methods.description: Checks if an encrypter has been set for the connection.

methods.name: one_rtt_keys_available
methods.description: Checks if the crypto handshake has completed and 1RTT keys are available.

methods.name: crypto_negotiated_params
methods.description: Returns the negotiated parameters from the crypto handshake.

methods.name: crypto_message_parser
methods.description: Provides the parser used for incoming crypto messages.

methods.name: OnPacketDecrypted
methods.description: Called when a packet at a specific encryption level has been decrypted.

methods.name: OnOneRttPacketAcknowledged
methods.description: Called when a 1RTT packet has been acknowledged.

methods.name: OnHandshakePacketSent
methods.description: Called when a handshake packet has been sent.

methods.name: OnHandshakeDoneReceived
methods.description: Called when handshake completion is received.

methods.name: OnNewTokenReceived
methods.description: Called when a new token frame is received.

methods.name: GetAddressToken
methods.description: Retrieves an address token based on cached network parameters.

methods.name: ValidateAddressToken
methods.description: Validates a given address token.

methods.name: PreviousCachedNetworkParams
methods.description: Returns the last cached network parameters received from a valid address token.

methods.name: SetPreviousCachedNetworkParams
methods.description: Sets the cached network parameters to be returned by PreviousCachedNetworkParams.

methods.name: GetHandshakeState
methods.description: Returns the current handshake state.

methods.name: SetServerApplicationStateForResumption
methods.description: Provides server-side application state for 0-RTT TLS resumption.

methods.name: BufferSizeLimitForLevel
methods.description: Returns max buffer size for a given encryption level.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Generates a decrypter for the next key phase.

methods.name: CreateCurrentOneRttEncrypter
methods.description: Creates an encrypter for the current key phase.

methods.name: GetSsl
methods.description: Returns the SSL object if using TLS1.3, otherwise nullptr.

methods.name: NeuterUnencryptedStreamData
methods.description: Cancels retransmission of unencrypted crypto stream data.

methods.name: NeuterStreamDataOfEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Cancels retransmission of data at a specific encryption level.

methods.name: OnStreamDataConsumed
methods.description: Records the amount of data consumed.

methods.name: HasPendingCryptoRetransmission
methods.description: Checks if there are crypto frames pending retransmission.

methods.name: WritePendingCryptoRetransmission
methods.description: Writes pending crypto frame retransmissions.

methods.name: WritePendingRetransmission
methods.description: Retransmits lost crypto data.

methods.name: RetransmitStreamDataAtLevel
methods.description: Retransmits stream data at a specific encryption level.

methods.name: crypto_bytes_read
methods.description: Returns total handshake bytes received.

methods.name: BytesReadOnLevel
methods.description: Returns handshake bytes received at a specific encryption level.

methods.name: BytesSentOnLevel
methods.description: Returns handshake bytes sent at a specific encryption level.

methods.name: WriteCryptoFrame
methods.description: Writes a crypto frame to a writer.

methods.name: OnCryptoFrameLost
methods.description: Handles lost crypto frames.

methods.name: RetransmitData
methods.description: Retransmits data indicated by a crypto frame.

methods.name: WriteBufferedCryptoFrames
methods.description: Writes buffered crypto frames.

methods.name: HasBufferedCryptoFrames
methods.description: Checks if there are buffered crypto frames.

methods.name: IsFrameOutstanding
methods.description: Checks if a crypto frame is outstanding.

methods.name: IsWaitingForAcks
methods.description: Checks if handshake data is waiting for acknowledgments.

methods.name: OnDataAvailableInSequencer
methods.description: Processes available data in the sequencer.

methods.name: GetStreamSequencerForPacketNumberSpace
methods.description: Retrieves the sequencer for a packet number space.

methods.name: IsCryptoFrameExpectedForEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Checks if a crypto frame is expected at a given encryption level.

methods.name: GetEncryptionLevelToSendCryptoDataOfSpace
methods.description: Determines the encryption level for sending crypto data.
